synopsis: “I’m the ace of the Evil Noblewoman’s Guild…and I have to play the heroine now? But I’ve only ever played a perfect villain!” An evil villainess heads toward her happy ending. Madeline is the ace of the Evil Noblewoman’s Guild, having starred in 93 different stories to date. For her next reincarnation, she had hoped to get an easy assignment that would help her score a promotion...but finds herself the heroine in a School Life Romance Novel! But with her pride on the line, Madeline is not one to run away from a challenge. With the help of guild Navigator Leold playing a handsome instructor, can Madeline successfully become a heroine and find her happy ending? Find out in this villainess-turned-heroine romantic comedy! (Source: Comikey)

Fortunately for him, he gets reincarnated after his death, and now he’s a young boy in a completely different world! One of Sirius’ unfulfilled tasks in his previous life was to pass on his knowledge and experience to a student, someone who could continue his legacy. Still wanting to fulfill this dream of his, he sets out to meet those who he will deem as pupils in this new world he’s been reincarnated into! synopsis: Job seeker Yu Hyang-Gi, struggling day by day, one day finds herself possessed by Hyang-Dan, the character from the traditional Korean folktale Chunhyangjeon. A supporting character, not even the heroine? How wonderful! Our beautiful young lady Chunhyang, and even a madam who cares for her like her own daughter. Hyang-Dan, who only felt the warmth of family after being possessed by the novel, was enjoying a peaceful life. Until "him" showed up! The world's ultimate villain, Byun Hak-Do, is destined to harass Chunhyang and be executed by the male protagonist, Lee Mong-Ryong. How dare he look down on our Chunhyang! "I don't know who you are, but you're a brat." "I've been waiting." "That's why I'm offering you this. An honor no one else can attain." But why do you keep entangling yourself with me? Why does that man care more about me than Chunhyang? A romantic fantasy about Hyang-Dan and Byeon Hak-Do, a twist on classic novels, Hyangdan's Tale. (Source: Kakaopage, translated)
